description: This file defines the Controller class for a plugin system, including its interfaces, internal classes, configuration, and lifecycle management. It manages plugin states, discovery, configuration, and event notifications within the Thunder plugin framework.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Main plugin controller class managing plugin lifecycle, configuration, discovery, and event notifications within the Thunder framework.

classes.name: Controller::Config
classes.description: Configuration container class for plugin settings, including probe parameters, resumes, subsystems, and UI toggle.

classes.name: Controller::Config::ProbeConfig
classes.description: Nested class defining probe-specific configuration such as TTL and node address.

classes.name: Controller::Sink
classes.description: Notification handler class for plugin and subsystem events, dispatching subsystem updates and state changes.

methods.name: Controller::SetServer
methods.description: Associates the plugin server and external subsystems with the controller, configuring subsystem defaults.

methods.name: Controller::NotifyStateControlStateChange
methods.description: Notifies registered observers of changes in the control state of a plugin identified by callsign.

methods.name: Controller::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service context.

methods.name: Controller::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the plugin is unloaded.

methods.name: Controller::Information
methods.description: Returns metadata information about the plugin.

methods.name: Controller::Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests, deserializing request data.

methods.name: Controller::Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.

methods.name: Controller::Delete
methods.description: Deletes a resource at the specified path.

methods.name: Controller::Destroy
methods.description: Destroys a plugin identified by callsign.

methods.name: Controller::StartDiscovery
methods.description: Starts device discovery with optional TTL.

methods.name: Controller::Hibernate
methods.description: Hibernates a plugin for a specified timeout.

methods.name: Controller::OnStateChangeEventRegistration
methods.description: Handles registration of state change events.

methods.name: Controller::OnStateControlStateChangeEventRegistration
methods.description: Handles registration of control state change events.

methods.name: Controller::Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a method on the plugin.

methods.name: Controller::FromIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves a plugin shell by callsign.

methods.name: Controller::SendInitialStateSnapshot
methods.description: Sends initial state snapshot to client.
